As part of the launch of the CARLINGUE brand, the CT-003-A model, produced in only 100 pieces, was produced. watches.description: The CARL-DIV-01 collection draws its identity from the 1950s and 1960s with the arrival of the so-called Skin Diver watches. Equipped with a glassbox-type sapphire crystal, a screw-down case back and crown, our divers have all the essential attributes for exploring the deep sea. All our models from the CARL-DIV-01 collection are equipped with Tropic type bracelets. These are the ones that fitted the most legendary and iconic diving watches of the sixties. For the special launch edition of the brand, the CT-001-A model, produced in just 100 pieces, is adorned with a bronze caseband*, a matching dial and hands, further asserting the personality adventurous and unique of our diver. * bronze, unlike 316L steel (which is stainless and hypoallergenic), oxidizes slightly over time, thus giving your watch a magnificent patina, making it unique. The watch can be restored to its original color and shine at any time by applying lemon juice (citric acid) for a few minutes and rinsing it with clean water.

watches.description: The CARL-AVI-01 collection is directly inspired by the timepieces that marked mid-20th century aeronautics with their codes and performances. Our watches feature dials inspired by aircraft dashboards, oversized fluted crowns for easier handling with gloves and bracelets made from robust materials to withstand the most extreme conditions. watches.description: Carlingue Diver 01 CT-001-A — Le caractère du bronze, l’esprit des plongeuses militaires La Diver 01 CT-001-A de Carlingue réinterprète l’esthétique des montres de plongée militaires historiques à travers une version en bronze au caractère affirmé. Inspirée des équipements utilisés par les plongeurs professionnels et militaires des années 50 et 60, cette pièce associe authenticité fonctionnelle, patine vivante et raffinement contemporain. Son boîtier en bronze développe au fil du temps une patine unique, propre à chaque montre et à son environnement, faisant de chaque Carlingue Diver 01 une pièce véritablement singulière. Cette matière emblématique renforce l’esprit utilitaire et aventureux du modèle tout en apportant une chaleur visuelle incomparable. Le cadran dégradé vert capte immédiatement le regard par sa profondeur et ses nuances évolutives selon la lumière. Pensé pour offrir une lisibilité optimale, il intègre une mire centrale servant de repère d’indexation. À l’époque, ce marquage constituait une aide visuelle supplémentaire pour les plongeurs en mission, leur permettant de se repérer rapidement dans des conditions de visibilité parfois difficiles. Ce détail historique emblématique participe pleinement à l’identité technique et militaire de la montre. Les index et aiguilles recouverts de Swiss Super-LumiNova® old radium assurent une lecture claire et instantanée, de jour comme sous faible luminosité, tandis que la glace saphir résistante aux rayures protège durablement le cadran. Animée par un mouvement automatique fiable et précis, la Carlingue Diver 01 en bronze perpétue la tradition des véritables montres-outils tout en offrant le confort et la qualité d’exécution attendus d’une montre contemporaine. Le bracelet ainsi que la boucle ardillon ont été entièrement dessinés par Carlingue afin de garantir une parfaite cohérence esthétique et fonctionnelle avec la montre. Chaque composant participe à l’équilibre global du design et à l’identité forte de cette plongeuse inspirée de l’histoire militaire. Avec son bronze vivant, son cadran vert dégradé et ses références assumées aux instruments de plongée d’époque, la Carlingue Diver 01 CT-001-A affirme une personnalité unique, pensée pour les passionnés d’horlogerie de caractère et d’aventure.

watches.description: The CARL-DIV-01 collection draws its identity from the 1950s and 1960s with the arrival of the so-called Skin Diver watches. Symbol of the exploration of the seabed, these watches with a very strong identity, with a water resistance of between 100 and 300 M, were thinner and more ergonomic than other professional diving watches. Equipped with a glassbox-type sapphire crystal, a screw-down case back and crown, our divers have all the essential attributes for exploring the deep sea. All our models from the CARL-DIV-01 collection are equipped with Tropic type bracelets. These are the ones that fitted the most legendary and iconic diving watches of the sixties. For the special launch edition of the brand, the CT-001-A model, produced in just 100 pieces, is adorned with a bronze caseband*, a matching dial and hands, further asserting the personality adventurous and unique of our diver. * bronze, unlike 316L steel (which is stainless and hypoallergenic), oxidizes slightly over time, thus giving your watch a magnificent patina, making it unique. The watch can be restored to its original color and shine at any time by applying lemon juice (citric acid) for a few minutes and rinsing it with clean water.

watches.name: CARL-AVI-01 / CT-002-A-CT / CRISTO
watches.description: The CARL-AVI-01 collection is directly inspired by the timepieces that marked mid-20th century aeronautics with their codes and performances. Everything is there: optimal readability day and night, sobriety and timelessness of design, functionality, advanced ergonomics... Our watches feature dials inspired by aircraft dashboards, oversized fluted crowns for easier handling with gloves and bracelets made from robust materials to withstand the most extreme conditions. In addition, these models are equipped with a fourth hand as well as a bidirectional rotating bezel which allows the time of a second time zone to be indicated over 24 hours. This GMT* function played a major role on transatlantic flights in the 1950s, so it was imperative that CARLINGUE offered it from its genesis. To further strengthen and assert the identity and DNA of these typical aviator watches, the CT-002-A model, produced in only 100 pieces for the launch of the brand, was developed. Its middle, as well as the strap buckle of this model, are adorned with a black PVD coating. In addition to its very aesthetic appearance, this treatment also makes the watch more resistant to knocks and scratches. ** * means Greenwich Mean Time and designates the mean solar time from the Greenwich meridian. ** in normal use of the watch (see warranty)
